Name: Ben Choucroun
Question: Which was more powerful, Jacen Solo or Kylo Ren? Which got the better stories?
Answer: Jacen Solo wins both categories. Power-wise, this isn’t even a contest. Jacen Solo was one of the most powerful characters in all of Star Wars. He nearly defeated Legacy of the Force Luke Skywalker multiple times, including once when he only had one arm. He was also implied to be able to destroy fleets, and was more powerful than UnuThul, including the entire Unu Killik nest. Jacen was also stated to be able to destroy Luke’s SteathX Jedi Starfighter. Meanwhile, Kylo Ren is virtually fearless. He has a couple of telekentic feats, and destroys some fodder Jedi. However, he was also ragdolled by Palpatine, and struggled way too much against 4 praetorian guards. Compare this to Jacen Solo, who was stronger than Dark Nest Luke Skywalker, who could move black holes, and it isn’t even a contest. Unsurprisingly, story-wise, it’s even more of a stomp in Jacen’s favor. Jacen has the best story arc in Star Wars, period. His story, from his humble beginnings as an animal loving Jedi apprentice to his fall to the Dark Side and eventually death, is beautifully told throughout over 60 books. His death at the hands of his sister is the saddest and most meaningful moment in all of Star Wars by a long shot. Meanwhile, we have Kylo Ren. His story is a cheap version of Jacen’s. He’s seduced to the Dark Side, murders a loved one, and dies saving the girl he’s in love with. But unlike Jacen’s, Kylo Ren’s story is full of plot holes. His motives are often shallow and don’t make much sense. He’s also edgy and annoying. In conclusion, though Jacen Solo and Kylo Ren have many similarities, Solo is both stronger and the better character. Stay safe, -Ben

Question: Who was Mace Windu’s Padawan(s)?
Answer: He had three, in Legends. Depa Billaba was a Jedi Master who served during the Clone Wars. Mace Windu taught her the dangerous form VII of lightsaber combat, Vaapad. However, while on a mission to Haruun Kal Billaba fell to the Dark Side and murdered her clone soldiers. Windu tracked down and defeated his former apprentice. Echuu Shen-Jon was another of Windu’s apprentices. Like Billaba, Shen-Jon became a Jedi Master. But unlike Windu, Shen-Jon survived the rise of the Empire and went on to become a general in the Rebel Alliance, sacrificing himself to save Leia Organa. Lastly, Devan For'deschel was a Jedi Master who served during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Very skilled at lightsaber combat, Fod’deschel was a powerful Jedi. However, that didn’t stop her from being killed on Almas by the Dark Jedi Garth Ezzar. So, Mace Windu had three apprentices. Impressively, all three became Jedi Masters. Stay safe, -Ben

Question: What are some popular Star Wars (in-universe) brand names? The same way Coca-Cola is a big brand in our world, what are some examples in Star Wars?
Answer: There are a couple fascinating fast food restaurants that were pretty big in the Star Wars galaxy. The first is Flangth-2-go, a popular restaurant during the days of the Empire. As its name would suggest, it sold flangth. It also commonly sponsored Jizz Musicians, such as Fitz Roi. There’s also Biscut Baron. Owned by Tagge. Co, this was the most popular chain restaurant during the Empire. It was similar to McDonalds, selling Jolly Meals. The restaurant sold meals not only for humans, but also for Wookiees, Sullustans, and a number of other species. Disaster struck, however, when Biscut Baron developed Bantha Breakfast Biscuit, a new dish. However, when placed in an autochef, the Bantha Breakfast Biscuit became a sentient lifeform known as the Giant Amorphous Bantha Breakfast Biscuit. These lifeforms were extremely ravenous, with one destroying the entire planet of Gastrula. The only way to destroy one was with Biscut Baron’s blue sauce. They were considered for biological warfare by the Empire. So, to conclude, those are some popular brands in Star Wars. Stay safe, -Ben

Question: Could a Jedi make a lightsaber with red Kyber crystals?
Answer: In Legends, yes. There are multiple examples of Jedi using red crystals to build their lightsaber. This is because is Legends, a lightsaber crystal’s color has nothing to do with the saner itself. For example, Daeshara’Cor, Leia Organa, and even Luke Skywalker all used red lightsabers. In conclusion, yes, it is perfectly possible for a Jedi to make a saber with red lightsaber crystals in Legends. Stay safe, -Ben

Question: Are there any ways to tell whether someone is force sensitive?
Answer: There are four methods which can be used to tell whether someone is force sensitive. The first is the most obvious- midichlorian tests. These calculate the amount of midichlorians per cell in someone’s body. Normal people will have around 2,500 midichlorians per cell, however, Anakin Skywalker had excess of over 20,000. The next is via a force scanning device belonging to Emperor Palpatine, and more broadly, Thaissen crystals. See, these crystals glowed blue around a light side user and red around a dark side user. These were put in a device and Palpatine, Luke and Brakiss, used this device to find force-sensitives. The next is a slightly unethical practice developed by Luke Skywalker. He would reach into people’s minds and try to feel their memories of something. If that person fought them off, such as Leia and Kyp Durron did, they were force sensitive. Finally, you could watch them and see if they use the force subconsciously. Anakin’s superior reflexes granted to him by the force allowed him to be the only human podracer. Or perhaps they get a bit too lucky in the casino. So, that is how you can determine whether someone is force-sensitive. Stay safe, -Ben
